passives: Debt With Teeth: Kharon Black Iron gains Contract Debt when its artillery choices express Infernal Dominion source-culture law through black-iron contract ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Kharon Black Iron is a colossal Infernal Dominion artillery from The Infernal Dominion. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Infernal Dominion artillery office: far-sight strike, horizon pressure, prophetic range; Chains: bondage, ownership, legal restraint, prison architecture.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source deity, not a costume: Kharon Black Iron shows black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.. Role silhouette must read as Artillery. Materials include black iron, volcanic glass, obsidian, blood wax, ash velvet, molten gold, charred parchment. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid red robot demon, generic Halloween devil, sci-fi cables, literal castle armor, block fortress body, cartoon pitchfork.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Kharon Black Iron — Black-Iron Clause Cut Longshot
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 5; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Horizon Lock
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Builds Contract Debt only when the Avatar uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Kharon Black Iron: Infernal Debt Verdict Cataclysm Line
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Kharon Black Iron Far-Sight Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Kharon Black Iron Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Kharon Black Iron Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Infernal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones
